anti_avoidance.note: ATO applies Part IVA general anti-avoidance provisions to 'asset wash sales'. No formal 30-day rule like Canada, but selling at a loss and reacquiring the same asset to crystallize losses may be challenged.

notes: Applies lot-level logic when holding-period data is available
CGT discount of 50% for assets held 12+ months before disposal (ATO excludes both acquisition and CGT event days)
Tax brackets are Stage 3 rates effective from 1 July 2024
ATO allows 'parcel' selection (specific identification) — taxpayer may choose which acquisition lot to dispose of. FIFO is used as default in this tool.
